title: ieee80211: Add different display filter for each WMM AC
description:
We can not get specific value for each access category in current implementation.
It is better to filter different values for BE, BK, VI or VO.
Removing hf_ieee80211_wfa_ie_wme_acp_cw_max and hf_ieee80211_wfa_ie_wme_acp_cw_min because
the type is wrong and using ecw max/min is similar for filter.
